name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Codes.exists_affine_relation
title: Affine relation over a field: more than d+1 vectors in K^d have a nonzero vanishing combination with coefficient sum 0
statement: Let K be a field and z_1, ..., z_N vectors in K^d with N > d + 1. There is a nonzero alpha in K^N with sum_j alpha_j = 0 and sum_j alpha_j z_j = 0. It is the field (Hamming-metric) counterpart of the integer affine short-syzygy lemma: over a field no coefficient bound is needed and the relation is found by Gaussian elimination. Consequence (note pq-we-non-lattice-algebras): a public F-linear zero test with d outputs on N >= d + 2 LPN or code encodings has exact fake zeros.
